author: TrakHound Inc.
name: TrakHound Function
description: Template to create a TrakHound Function Project

skipRestore.description: Skips restoring the project's NuGet packages after it is created

trakhoundVersion.description: Version of the TrakHound NuGet packages to reference. Use the TrakHound version of the Instance you deploy to (or older)

instanceUrl.description: The URL of the Instance the debug host connects to

localTarget.description: Adds the 'local' Publish Target to trakhound.package.publish.json : the Dev Package Server of the development Instance at instanceUrl (ex. trakhound/instance-dev). Set it to false in a repository that has a shared trakhound.package.publish.json (without managementServer or organization, the file is then left out)

managementServer.description: The Package Server of the 'default' Publish Target in trakhound.package.publish.json, which is then the defaultTarget

organization.description: The Organization of the 'default' Publish Target in trakhound.package.publish.json, which is then the defaultTarget

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
